<!--
Landing page template for a tutorial (openspec/templates/tutorial-index.qmd), laid out like
fundamentals-of-mathematics-for-physicists/index.qmd. Copy it to <tutorial>/index.qmd and replace every <placeholder>.

- The landing page does not list the chapters: the tutorial's sidebar does. Add the tutorial's own sidebar (id = its
  folder) to _quarto.yml, with an "← All tutorials" link first and then the chapters flat, one entry per chapter folder
  (<chapter-slug>/index.qmd), in reading order; no parts or nested lists. Each chapter starts from
  openspec/templates/chapter.qmd. A planned chapter (a placeholder page) is entered as
  `text: '<Title> <span class="sidebar-badge">planned</span>'` with its `href`. Add a _metadata.yml in the folder
  with `sidebar: <folder>`.
- The `start-reading` block points to the first page of the tutorial (its notation page, or a preface).
- Anything else goes in its own "##" section after that block, e.g. "Software for symbolic computation". Add one
  section per such topic, and none if there is nothing to add.
- The categories are the tutorial's topics: they are shown as chips in the title block, each linking to the home page
  filtered by that topic, and they appear among the topic chips of the home page.
- The notation page (notation/index.qmd) comes first: it includes the shared tables from _notation/ that the
  tutorial uses and ends with "## Conventions specific to this tutorial".
-->
